data.explanation: Finanzamt Musterbergen has formally recorded a loss carryforward (Verlustvortrag) from your Master's studies expenses. This is not a bill – no payment is due. The loss can later be offset against future taxable income, reducing tax you owe once you start earning. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline for this above. If you do nothing, the amount becomes final. Keep this notice for future tax returns, since it affects how much loss you can carry forward.

items.title: Object to the loss carryforward amount (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessed loss carryforward, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically, or in person at Finanzamt Musterbergen
items.consequence: The assessed loss carryforward of €4,806.00 becomes final and binding if you do not object by the deadline shown

data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbergen notifies Tarek Beispiel that the remaining loss carryforward for income tax as of 31 December 2025 has been assessed at €4,806.00, arising from negative income from his Master's studies (anticipated income-related expenses/vorweggenommene Werbungskosten). This loss will be offset against future positive income.
